BEGIN_SIGNATURE:M104
@MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} β]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} β} [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_2} ν]
  [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_1} μ] (s : Set.{u_1} α) (t : Set.{u_2} β),
  Eq.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict.{u_1} μ s)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict.{u_2} ν t))
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict.{max u_1 u_2} (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} μ ν)
      (SProd.sprod.{u_1, u_2, max u_1 u_2} s t))
BEGIN_AXIOMS:M104
'MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice.{u}, Quot.sound.{u}]
